title: GB F-gas quota transfer and authorisation QA controls

sources.title: Transfer and authorise F gas quota to another business
Incumbent F gas quota holders and authorisation managers in Great Britain

facts.source_fact: A quota holder can transfer quota to another bulk HFC producer or importer.
A quota holder can authorise another company to use quota for pre-charged equipment.
A quota holder or authorisation manager can delegate qualifying authorisations to a third party.
Quota expires on 31 December each year.
Transactions must be completed before 31 December to count in that calendar year.
New entrants cannot transfer their quota under the stated rules.
Additional quota applied for as an incumbent cannot be transferred under the stated restriction.
Delegated authorisations cannot themselves be transferred by an equipment importer or manufacturer.
Quota cannot be transferred between the EU system and the GB system.
The published incumbent list covers quota holders and authorisation managers for the stated GB reference period; list membership is not an emissions measurement.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer emissions from list status.
